children.text: CLAIMED: over all 625 quadruples, every form that is true of ALL of them is also invariant under the mirror (a,b,c,d) ↦ (d,c,b,a) — so a conjunct that cannot fail is symmetric for free, and padding is symmetry's degenerate limit rather than its opposite.
(allQ (fun a b c d => !(everywhere a b c d) || (mirrorAgrees a b c d))) = true
theorem emptiness_is_invariant_under_every_mirror : (allQ (fun a b c d => !(everywhere a b c d) || (mirrorAgrees a b c d))) = true := by decide

CLAIMED: the converse FAILS — the symmetric cross a·d = b·c is invariant under the mirror and is NOT true of every quadruple, so symmetry with content exists and invariance is not merely a symptom of saying nothing.
((allQ (fun a b c d => (symmetric a b c d) == (symmetric d c b a))) = true) ∧ ¬(1 * 1 = 2 * 2)
theorem symmetry_with_content_is_not_emptiness : ((allQ (fun a b c d => (symmetric a b c d) == (symmetric d c b a))) = true) ∧ ¬(1 * 1 = 2 * 2) := by decide

CLAIMED: classifying a form by (true everywhere, invariant under the mirror) leaves exactly 3 of the four cells occupied — and the missing one, true everywhere yet not invariant, is IMPOSSIBLE rather than merely unobserved: the first theorem excludes it.
(anyQ (fun a b c d => !(symmetric a b c d))) = true ∧ (allQ (fun a b c d => !(everywhere a b c d) || (mirrorAgrees a b c d))) = true
theorem the_square_has_no_fourth_cell : (anyQ (fun a b c d => !(symmetric a b c d))) = true ∧ (allQ (fun a b c d => !(everywhere a b c d) || (mirrorAgrees a b c d))) = true := by decide
